name: Industrial Red Oxide Zinc Chromate Anti-Corrosive Metal Primer
shortDescription: Heavy-duty anti-corrosive primer formulated with synthetic red iron oxide and zinc chromate rust inhibitors for structural steel, PEB framing, and tanks.
overview: This Industrial Red Oxide Zinc Chromate Primer is the frontline defensive foundation for all structural steelwork, pre-engineered buildings (PEBs), tanks, and industrial fabrications. Compounded with pure synthetic red iron oxide pigments and active zinc chromate anti-corrosive agents in an oil-modified phenolic alkyd resin vehicle, it provides both a physical moisture barrier and sacrificial electrochemical rust inhibition. It bites aggressively into degreased mild steel, blast-cleaned steel, and cast iron, forming a high-tooth matte foundation that bonds tenaciously with enamel, epoxy, and polyurethane topcoats.
keyFeatures: Dual-action rust inhibition: Synthetic red iron oxide barrier + active zinc chromate passivation
Stops electrochemical oxidation and prevents rust creep beneath topcoats
High-solids formulation provides excellent single-coat hiding and film build (30-35µm DFT)
Tenacious adhesion to blast-cleaned and manually de-rusted steel surfaces
Matte high-tooth finish provides exceptional mechanical anchor for all enamel topcoats
Fast drying time: touch dry within 30 minutes, allowing rapid handling in fabrication yards
Conforms to IS 2074 standards for ready-mixed red oxide zinc chrome metal primers

specifications.Type: Air Drying Oil-Modified Phenolic Alkyd Primer

applications: Structural steel roof trusses, purlins, and columns in PEB warehouses

Automotive chassis frames, tippers, and agricultural implements
Commercial steel railings, rolling shutters, and architectural frames
